risk_flags.reason: scripts/migrate-tighten-description-topic.js executes `DROP TABLE documents` (diff.patch:27) as part of a table-swap. `documents` is Parent-of-Sacred: it cascades into `questions` and through it `session_answers`. If FK cascade is active, dropping the table destroys those sacred child rows. This is the exact schema-tightening table-swap-on-documents pattern, framed as 'close-out', that destroyed 790 questions and 746 answers on 2026-04-27. DEC-U06's 'small, low-risk' note is not an enumerated pre-approval for a destructive write path on a sacred-parent table.

The migration has already been run (executor_report commands_run + evidence/migration-output.txt show before/after output), so any cascade loss may already have occurred against a live DB. The script runs each statement separately with no transaction wrapping (diff.patch:35-37), so a mid-sequence failure after DROP is unrecoverable. No reversal evidence exists.

Acceptance criterion #2 ('no data loss anywhere') and #3 ('verified') are unmet: the built-in check only counts the directly-modified `documents` table (22→22, evidence/migration-output.txt:2-3) and never inspects cascade-dependent sacred tables questions/session_answers. Per doctrine, verification covering only the modified table is not verification. The new documents_new schema also omits any FK/constraint definitions present on the original (diff.patch:14-24), an unreviewed schema change.
